decks.name: LeetCode #48 - Rotate Image
decks.description: Rotate a 2D matrix 90 degrees clockwise in-place

cards.question: Rotate Image: You are given an n x n 2D matrix representing an image, rotate the image by 90 degrees clockwise. You have to rotate the image in-place, which means you have to modify the input 2D matrix directly. DO NOT allocate another 2D matrix and do the rotation.

solutions.name: Reverse And Transpose
solutions.explanation: Reverse the matrix vertically, then transpose it. Reversing flips rows upside down, and transposing swaps rows with columns. These two operations combined achieve a 90-degree clockwise rotation. Most elegant solution.
